Maya (product): Quick design review — walked through the new API credential onboarding and visibility tweaks. Leaving a few UX + a11y nits here. Fig links: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz (screenshots attached). Sahil (design): LGTM overall. main thing: the empty state feels dense. can we surface a single primary CTA + a subtle secondary action instead of the 3-up layout? Alex (frontend): Agreed. also the `Show secret` behaviour currently expands inline and moves the page. keyboard focus isn't trapped, which breaks expectation. Samira (accessibility): +1 on focus. If `Show secret` reveals a region, we should use `aria-expanded` on the button and set `role="region"` with `aria-live="polite"` for screen readers. propose this snippet:```html
••••••
``` Maya (product): Good call. Also thinking about onboarding: new users don't know scopes vs roles. Can we add a one-line helper under the permission selector: "Scopes limit what this credential can access (recommended)" with a tooltip? Sahil (design): I like a microcopy approach: "Limit this key to only the APIs it needs." Tooltip with short examples (embeddings, generation). Keeps UI lightweight. Alex (frontend): Implementation note: adding tooltip + examples is straightforward. For the permission selector, we should show the current selection as pill chips so it's obvious which scopes are set. chips also copy well to mobile. Samira (accessibility): Chips are fine if keyboard navigable and announce state. Ensure `aria-selected` on active chips and `tabindex="0"`/`-1` cycling. Maya (product): Another UX edge: rotate flow. Right now rotate does a hard modal that immediately revokes old key when you confirm. Customers wanted a grace period & undo. Suggest: show a two-step rotate modal: 1) generate new key and download, 2) optional revoke old key with a 24h auto-revoke toggle + undo toast. Sahil (design): We can present it as progressive disclosure. Primary CTA: "Generate replacement" then show a small checklist: download, update clients, revoke. The revoke toggle can default off for conservative behavior. Alex (frontend): We'll need to add a server flag for delayed revoke. also add `data-test` attrs for e2e. Suggest toast message: "Credential rotated. Old key will auto-revoke in 24h — Undo" with an `Undo` action that cancels revoke. Samira (accessibility): Toast undo must be reachable by keyboard and announced by SR. Use `role="status"` and ensure focus isn't stolen. Maya (product): Revoke flow UX: confirm modal copy is scaring folks. Current copy: "This action cannot be undone." suggests permanence (which is correct) but we should surface consequences (failed jobs, integrations) and recommend a checklist before revoke. Short safer copy: "Revoking will stop apps using this credential. Consider rotating first or creating a replacement." Sahil (design): Maybe add a secondary inline checklist link: "How to rotate safely" that opens a small inline panel instead of sending them to docs. Keeps them in-context. Alex (frontend): For empty-state of credential hub: suggest one primary CTA "Create credential" and a subtle inline example: "Create a read-only key to run embeddings — learn more" with a `?` help link. Avoid three large CTAs which compete. Samira (accessibility): Ensure the empty-state has heading hierarchy (h1/h2) and that the CTA is first focusable element. Also add meaningful alt text on illustrations. Maya (product): Minor copy tweaks: change button label from `Create new` to `Create credential` (explicit), change `Download once` microcopy to: "Copy and store securely — you won't be able to view this secret again." Sahil (design): Also propose a visibility affordance when a secret is displayed: show a subtle badge "Exposed" with a tooltip explaining ephemeral viewing and recommend rotation. Alex (frontend): We'll add a small audit event on `Show secret` and surface a row in the activity feed "Secret viewed" with user and timestamp. Devs: any privacy concerns? Samira (accessibility): Audit event fine, but when showing the activity feed, ensure it can be filtered and SR friendly. No PII leaked in feed entries (mask emails). deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: creds-ui/a11y-fixes -> staging at 2026-04-04T07:30Z :rocket: Maya (product): Thanks all — action items summarized: Sahil to update screens with single CTA & rotate checklist; Alex to implement aria-expanded for `Show secret`, toast undo, and delayed revoke flag; Samira to write a11y acceptance criteria for chips, toast, and inline region; Maya to update copylines and create the small inline rotate guide. I'll follow up with a quick Figma pass. :thumbsup: Sahil (design): I'll drop the updated frames by EOD and attach variations for the empty-state illustration (compact vs spacious). Alex (frontend): Will pick up the a11y branch after staging deploy. ETA 3 days. Samira (accessibility): I'll add test cases to the axe checklist and run a quick screen reader pass on staging once deployed. Maya (product): Perfect. closing loop here — ping if anything blocks.
